description.value: Chong Lee Market is a long-running Chinese and Asian grocery store that has served Vancouver since 1987, with this Fraserview location on Victoria Drive open since 2003. It stocks a wide range of fresh produce, seafood, Chinese BBQ, and multicultural pantry products, and also serves fresh-made Banh Mi at this location. A loyalty card program and weekly flyers make it a practical neighbourhood resupply stop.
